taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from Pelvic wall and viscera.

words.clue: Muscle that supports pelvic viscera and raises the pelvic floor during Valsalva maneuver.
Part of levator ani that maintains the anorectal angle and prevents fecal incontinence.
Pelvic muscle also called ischiococcygeus that supports the pelvic floor.
Artery that supplies medial thigh muscles and may form corona mortis over the pectineal line.
Superior and inferior arteries exiting via the sciatic foramina relative to piriformis.
Internal artery that exits the greater sciatic foramen and re-enters via the lesser sciatic foramen.
Artery that crosses the ureter 2 centimeters lateral to the cervix during hysterectomy.
Artery supplying the fundus and upper ureter of the urinary bladder.
Major nerve of the sacral plexus supplying the entire lower limb below the knee.
Muscle of the pelvic floor located anterior to the sacrum where the sacral plexus forms.
Descent of the uterus through the vaginal introitus caused by weakening of pelvic floor muscles.
